notes: Compatibility uses npm-style range syntax: ^1.0.0 means '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'. The asset_registry.py loader resolves ranges.
breaking_versions is an explicit deny-list for known-incompatible point releases (empty for all current assets).
When an asset bumps to 2.0.0, this registry's compatibility field updates to ^2.0.0 and consumers expecting ^1.0.0 will get a structured CompatibilityError instead of silent empty results.
consumer_declared_requirements documents what each consumer expects; consumers should NOT hardcode versions in their code anymore — they should call registry.required_for(consumer_name).
